top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a complete, mature physiological chain: proglucagon processing, the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide, human incretin physiology and receptor biology, independently validated by large randomized outcome trials. The three-name allocation and a citation scoped to the physiology and active form avoid adjudicating the Mojsov/Habener priority question or crediting a drug class; the attribution gap is a wording issue, not a reason to withhold the prize.
